name: dumbbell incline powell raise
description: A Powell raise performed while lying on one side against an incline bench, lifting a light dumbbell out from below the shoulder.
instructions: Lie on your side against an incline bench with a light dumbbell in the upper hand.
Let the working arm hang below the shoulder with a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the dumbbell out and slightly back to about shoulder height, keeping the torso supported.
Lower slowly, then turn over to train the other shoulder.
